symptom: npm run lint in object-oriented reported 727 problems, almost all 'Delete ␍' from Prettier
root_cause: clone checked out with core.autocrlf=true on Windows, so files had CRLF while the project enforces LF
fix: repo-local core.autocrlf=false and re-checkout of both forks

symptom: pnpm -v crashed: corepack could not find pnpm.cjs
root_cause: broken corepack cache on this laptop
fix: not needed: the projects use npm lockfiles; used npm 10.9

symptom: the planned fix for object-oriented tests overlapped an existing open upstream PR (#1, Feb 2026)
root_cause: diagnosis started from failing tests before reading the upstream PR list
fix: dropped that improvement and chose use-case tests and root CI instead; documented in docs/diagnostico.md
prevented_by: read upstream open PRs before choosing improvements

symptom: 3 prettier errors per project in the new createCourse.spec.ts (long template literals)
root_cause: generated test lines over the print width
prevented_by: run lint:fix before the first test run

symptom: validate.sh reported every target as failed: 'No such file or directory' for the log files
root_cause: log path was relative to the repo root but the commands ran after cd into each worktree
prevented_by: shellcheck / a dry run with one target

symptom: Jest found 0 tests inside the validation worktrees
root_cause: worktrees lived under .validate/ and Jest's testMatch globs skip dot-directories

symptom: git worktree remove failed with 'Filename too long' (node_modules)
fix: core.longpaths=true for the removal and automatic cleanup at the end of validate.sh
prevented_by: core.longpaths=true from the start on Windows

symptom: code review simulated 2M faker sentences: 'saves a valid course' could fail about 1 in 4,650 runs
root_cause: CourseMother uses faker.lorem.sentence(), which can exceed the 100-char title limit; 5 repeated runs could not reveal it
fix: fixed valid title in the tests that depend on it; PR text no longer claims flakiness was ruled out
prevented_by: bounded test data (property-based reasoning) instead of repeat runs

symptom: the CI PR would arrive with a red object-oriented job, lowering the chance of acceptance
root_cause: matrix included an example that is broken on upstream main pending someone else's PR
fix: object-oriented left out of the matrix with a comment; also permissions: contents: read and actions v5
prevented_by: ask 'will this PR be green on arrival?' before pushing

symptom: the fork README section disappeared from main and showed up in the ci/root-workflow PR branch
root_cause: 'git commit -am' on the PR branch also committed the README edit carried over from main's working tree (999ea05)
fix: new commit on the branch restoring README.md to upstream (force-push was not allowed); net PR diff is only ci.yml; README section restored on main
prevented_by: never 'commit -a' on PR branches: 'git add <paths>' or a separate worktree per branch
